g.text: The same example IDs for both models. Confidence quality is shown alongside top-label accuracy.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #586671

g.text: ScienceQA: official test image subset. VQAv2: independent split of the validation pool. These are not the model-card splits.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #586671

g.text: Laya Vision has possible VQAv2 training exposure and A-OKVQA checkpoint-selection exposure; this is not a blind comparison.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #586671

g.text: Laya: FP32 CPU, 2,048-token total/head budgets. Dohnuts: BF16. ECE: 15 bins, deployed temperatures, no per-task refit.
